answers.label: Neutron
answers.desc: nucleon (constituent of the nucleus of the atom) that has neutral electric charge (no charge); symbol n

answers.label: Photon
answers.desc: elementary particle, the carrier and quantum of electromagnetism

answers.label: Neutrino
answers.desc: elementary particle with extremely low mass that interacts only via the weak force and gravity

answers.label: Electron neutrino
answers.desc: neutral subatomic elementary particle of first generation of leptons

answers.label: Muon
answers.desc: elementary subatomic particle with negative electric charge

answers.label: Quark
answers.desc: elementary particles that make up hadrons in the Standard Model of particle physics

answers.label: Top quark
answers.desc: the heaviest of the six known flavors of quarks

answers.label: Gluon
answers.desc: elementary particle that mediates the strong force

answers.label: W boson
answers.desc: charged elementary particle that mediate the weak interaction W boson

answers.label: Z boson
answers.desc: electrically neutral elementary particle that mediate the weak interaction Z boson

answers.label: Higgs boson
answers.desc: elementary particle transmitting the Higgs field giving particles mass

answers.label: Graviton
answers.desc: hypothetical elementary particle that mediates gravitation

answers.label: Pion
answers.desc: lightest meson with a quark and an antiquark

answers.label: Meson
answers.desc: subatomic particle; hadron made of equal number of quark(s) and antiquark(s): normally one of each

answers.label: Baryon
answers.desc: proton or any other hadron that is composed of an odd number of quarks (at least three)

answers.label: Hadron
answers.desc: quantum particle: bound system of quark(s) and/or antiquark(s)

answers.label: Lepton
answers.desc: class of elementary fermions that do not undergo strong interaction

answers.label: Fermion
answers.desc: quantum system whose wave function changes when exchanging identical instances

answers.label: Boson
answers.desc: quantum system invariant by exchange of two identical instances

answers.label: Lambda baryon
answers.desc: baryon made of specific quark combinations

answers.label: Sigma baryon
answers.desc: baryon made of specific quark combinations

answers.label: Eta meson
answers.desc: isosinglet meson made of a mixture of up, down and strange quarks and their antiquarks

answers.label: Rho meson
answers.desc: meson that carries the nuclear force

answers.label: J/psi meson
answers.desc: neutral meson having charm quark and charm anti quark

answers.label: Tachyon
answers.desc: hypothetical particle with imaginary mass which is hypothesized to always travel faster-than-light

answers.label: Nucleon
answers.desc: particle that makes up the atomic nucleus (proton or neutron)

answers.label: Triton
answers.desc: atomic nucleus; having the symbol t, ³H⁺ or T⁺, is the +1 ion of tritium, ³H or T

answers.label: Majorana fermion
answers.desc: fermion that is its own antiparticle

answers.label: Sterile neutrino
answers.desc: hypothetical neutral right-handed lepton that interacts only via gravity and not via any of the other fundamental interactions of the Standard Model

answers.label: Preon
answers.desc: "point-like" particle postulated as making up quarks and leptons

answers.label: Neutralino
answers.desc: hypothetical particle, neutral mass eigenstate formed from superpartners of gauge and Higgs bosons

answers.label: Inflaton
answers.desc: hypothetical scalar field driving cosmic inflation

answers.label: Pentaquark
answers.desc: exotic baryon consisting of five quarks

answers.label: Tetraquark
answers.desc: exotic meson composed of four valence quarks

answers.label: Glueball
answers.desc: a composite particle made of gluons bound by the strong force
